settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure global behavior for Codex Switcher.
settings.autoWarmupDescription: Automatically warm eligible accounts based on their usage status.
settings.timedWarmupDescription: Warm eligible accounts at specific times each day.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used throughout the application.
settings.timeDisplayDescription: Show local time and OpenAI/UTC time in the title bar for easier quota reset comparisons.
settings.taskbarDescription: Show Codex limits beside the Windows notification area.
settings.taskbarWidthDescription: Long account names use smart middle ellipsis; hover the widget to see the full name.
settings.taskbarOffsetDescription: Fine-tune the widget position in physical pixels. Positive X moves right; positive Y moves down.
settings.floatingDescription: Keep a modern usage card above your work.
settings.clickThroughDescription: Mouse input passes through to windows underneath. Enabling it exits compact mode; use the floating controls to turn it off.
settings.alwaysOnTopDescription: Keep the card above other windows without disabling dragging, width resizing, or hover details.
settings.updateDescription: Check GitHub Releases for a newer version of Codex Switcher.

header.showAll: Show all account aliases and emails
header.hideAll: Hide all account aliases and emails
header.warmupAll: Send minimal traffic using all accounts
header.disableAutoAll: Disable auto warm-up for all accounts
header.enableAutoAll: Enable auto warm-up for all accounts
header.timedTitle: Schedule warm-up at specific times of day for all accounts

closeBehavior.title: Keep Codex Switcher in the Dock?
closeBehavior.body: When the window is closed, Codex Switcher can stay in the Dock or live only in the menu bar.
closeBehavior.changeLater: You can always change this later from the tray popup.

reauth.title: Reauthorize account
reauth.description: Click “Start reauthorization” to open the ChatGPT authorization page in your browser. Complete authorization with the ChatGPT account associated with this entry. Codex Switcher will update its credentials without creating a duplicate account or switching the currently active account.
reauth.validating: The new credentials were saved. Validating account and usage status…
reauth.success: Reauthorization succeeded and the new credentials are active.
reauth.savedButValidationFailed: The new credentials were saved, but the follow-up status check did not succeed.
reauth.pageErrorTitle: Did the browser show an authentication error?
reauth.pageErrorHelp: Confirm the common deactivation notice, paste the browser error, or paste the full text of a deactivation email from OpenAI below for verification.
reauth.reportAccountDeactivated: Page says account deleted or deactivated
reauth.pastePageError: Copy and paste the authorization error
reauth.pageErrorPlaceholder: Paste browser error, email content (subject/sender/date/body), or enter account_deactivated
reauth.pageErrorRecorded: Waiting stopped and this account was recorded as deactivated based on the submitted information.
reauth.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard does not contain any recognizable text.
reauth.clipboardReadFailed: Could not read the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V in the text box to paste manually.
reauth.copyLinkFailed: Could not copy the login link. Select the link and copy it manually.

deactivationReport.help: Paste the complete OpenAI deactivation email. Codex Switcher will verify the deactivation wording, account email, and notice date before marking this account as deactivated.

deactivationReport.emailMismatch: This email does not match the selected account.
deactivationReport.recorded: The email was recorded and this account is now marked as deactivated.
deactivationReport.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard does not contain any text.
deactivationReport.clipboardReadFailed: Could not read the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V in the text box to paste manually.
